Two 512 x 512 px pictures of a partly cloudy Sentinel-2 L2A pass over Guwahati
(S2B_46RCP_20251012_0_L2A), saved as plain JPGs to try the picture upload mode.
The natural colour one is the true-colour (TCI) layer, the false colour one is NIR/Red/Green.

Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025, from the Element 84 Earth Search catalogue on AWS.
